description: This file defines classes for handling 'ignoredisk' commands in kickstart installation scripts, including different versions and options for disk exclusion during system installation.

classes.name: FC3_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Handles ignoredisk command for FC3 version, allowing specification of disks to ignore.

classes.name: F8_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Extends FC3_IgnoreDisk with additional options for --only-use.

classes.name: RHEL6_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Adds interactive option support for RHEL6 version.

classes.name: F14_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Placeholder class for F14 version, inherits from RHEL6_IgnoreDisk.

classes.name: F25_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Further extends previous classes with additional drive/only-use options.

classes.name: F29_IgnoreDisk
classes.description: Overrides parse method, inherits from F25_IgnoreDisk, adds deprecated --interactive argument.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ignore disk command object with optional ignoredisk or onlyuse lists.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command, including ignored disks or options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and sets object attributes accordingly.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser configured for the specific version.
